title: RepoSnapshot Crawler Output Graph
$comment: Flat BFS-ordered array. NodeDepth is non-decreasing across items (enforced by crawler post-condition; not expressible as a cross-item JSON Schema constraint). Position [0] is always the root node — enforced by prefixItems.
description: Exhaustive flat array of all directory nodes produced by DiscoveryCrawler.Invoke(). NodePaths are relative to the snapshot root. Input to the ignore engine via GetProjection().

GlobPattern.description: A raw glob pattern string. May begin with '!' for negation. Blank lines and comment lines (#) are stripped before storage.

GlobArray.description: Array of glob pattern strings, or null when the source param was $null at invocation time. Empty array = param was provided but contained no patterns.

IgnoreFileEntry.title: IgnoreFileEntry
IgnoreFileEntry.description: One ignore source at a directory node. Source is either a filename basename found on disk, or the reserved virtual name 'IgnorePatterns' for param-injected rules (root node only, always first entry).

Source.description: Basename of the ignore file (e.g. '.gitignore', '.snapignore'), or the reserved name 'IgnorePatterns' for the virtual root param-injected source. No path separators permitted.

ExecutiveOverrides.title: ExecutiveOverrides
ExecutiveOverrides.description: Root-only bypass mechanism. Always present as an object on the root node. Globs null = $ExecutiveOverrides param was not provided — normal ignore pipeline active. Globs [] = param was provided but empty. Globs non-empty = bypass active: ignore pipeline skipped, globs compiled to a single regex with inverted semantics (match = KEEP).

FileEntry.title: FileEntry
FileEntry.description: A single file collected during BFS traversal of a directory node. Files within each node are alphabetically ordered.

AbsolutePath.description: Absolute path, forward-slash normalized. Must NOT end with '/'.

DirectoryNode.title: DirectoryNode
DirectoryNode.description: A non-root directory node. No root-only fields.

NodePath.description: Path relative to snapshot root, forward-slash, trailing '/' required. Single-segment example: 'src/'. Multi-segment: 'src/lib/'.

AbsolutePath.description: Absolute path to this directory, forward-slash normalized, trailing '/' required.

NodeDepth.description: Depth below snapshot root. Non-root nodes are always >= 1.

IgnoreFiles.description: Ignore sources discovered at this node. May be empty.

Files.description: Files directly in this directory, alphabetically ordered.

RootDirectoryNode.title: RootDirectoryNode
RootDirectoryNode.description: The snapshot root node. NodePath is always '' (empty string). Adds two root-only structural invariants: (1) ExecutiveOverrides object always present — Globs null/empty = inactive, non-empty = bypass active. (2) IgnoreFiles must contain a 'IgnorePatterns' virtual source as its first entry — always injected from the $IgnorePatterns param, Globs may be null or empty.

NodePath.description: Always empty string for the root node.

AbsolutePath.description: Absolute path to the snapshot root, forward-slash normalized, trailing '/' required.

IgnoreFiles.description: Ignore sources at root. First entry must always be the virtual 'IgnorePatterns' source. Subsequent entries are disk-sourced files in alphabetical discovery order.

Files.description: Files directly in the root directory, alphabetically ordered.
